title: Neural Oracle
description: A dark-skinned figure with intricate circuit-like patterns on their face and glowing white eyes sits at a purple table. Three glowing orbs float above the table containing a dripping hotdog, an abstract patterned sphere with eyes, and a hamburger, while white lightning connects the figure to the orbs against a black background with yellow and red dripping paint and circuit board patterns.
prompt: A surreal cyberpunk figure with dark skin covered in white circuit board tattoos and glowing white eyes, wearing a complex braided hairstyle with flowers, sits at a purple table. Three luminous orbs float before them containing a dripping hotdog, a patterned orb with yellow eyes, and a hamburger. White lightning arcs from the figure to the orbs. Black background with dripping yellow and red paint streaks and circuit patterns, intricate linework, mystical atmosphere.
